description: Capabilities the paneflow serve worker advertises to every Controller at bootstrap. A Controller reads this set once and never probes for a feature by trying it.

capabilities.name: agent.snapshot
capabilities.summary: agent.snapshot returns the worker's reduced activity for every session it knows.

capabilities.name: agent.follow
capabilities.summary: agent.follow streams agent.snapshot once, then one agent.event frame per accepted transition.

capabilities.name: restart.recommendation
capabilities.summary: A session carries restart_recommended when the core's host_protocol_version is below the version this worker requires.

capabilities.name: control.proxy
capabilities.summary: surface.* and session.* control methods are forwarded verbatim to the PTY core on the caller's behalf.

capabilities.name: fleet.projection
capabilities.summary: fleet.list and surface.status are answered from the worker's reduced activity, not from core state.

capabilities.name: integrations.refresh
capabilities.summary: The worker re-runs the installers of installed integrations at start and adopts legacy per-launch installs once.

capabilities.name: activity.reducer
capabilities.summary: Busy, idle and attention follow hook events once a session latches; a five-minute lease re-armed only by a changed screen signal bounds a lost stop, and stale runtime generations are refused.

capabilities.name: activity.notifications
capabilities.summary: The worker decides when a session finished or needs input and publishes that decision as notify on the agent.event frame; screen-sourced edges never carry one.

capabilities.name: agent.activity_log
capabilities.summary: agent.activity_log returns the worker's bounded history of settled turns with their outcome: completed, failed:<reason>, expired or cancelled.
